source_segments.text: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Solemn, resonant church bells begin tolling rhythmically from the cathedral above, echoing deep into the stone dungeon.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Startled Whisper)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Bells.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Realizing)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: The wedding.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Grim)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: It's beginning.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Somber, Steely)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Then I suppose I'm next.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Alexander...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Dramatic cut to black.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: A sharp, high-tension dramatic swell strikes and echoes out into silence alongside the fading toll of the distant church bells.

hook: A firewood cart approaches the grand cathedral guards, suddenly turning into a violent takedown that immediately grabs attention.
cliffhanger: The guards are neutralized, and the loyalists declare the road clear and send word to the Duke.
standalone_clarity: New viewers can easily understand an undercover ambush on guards, even without knowing the broader conspiracy.
narrative_context: Alexander's loyalists execute the first phase of their plan by silently and swiftly neutralizing the royal guards at the cathedral entrance.
promotional_strength: Combines stealth action with a sudden burst of physical conflict, offering a high-stakes entry point for new viewers.

evidence.observation: The cart driver suddenly attacks the sentry.
A second loyalist takes down the remaining guard with a sleeper hold.

logline: While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide crane shot panning down as a horse-drawn cart loaded with cut firewood pulls up along the wet stone pavement in front of the cathedral steps.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: A lone driver in rugged attire guides the horse cart slowly toward the sentries guarding the arched entryway.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of the royal sentry stepping forward and extending a white-gloved hand to halt the cart.

source_segments.label: ROYAL SENTRY (Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: ROYAL SENTRY
source_segments.text: Stop!

source_segments.label: CART DRIVER (Meek, Deferential)
source_segments.speaker: CART DRIVER
source_segments.text: Firewood for the kitchens, sir.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST FIGHTER (Whispering, Cold)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
source_segments.text: Sleep.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.

source_segments.label: CART DRIVER (Relieved, Firm)
source_segments.speaker: CART DRIVER
source_segments.text: The road is clear.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST FIGHTER (Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
source_segments.text: Tell the Duke.

hook: Alexander cuts away his long beard and rugged disguise in the mirror, instantly transforming back into an imposing nobleman.
cliffhanger: Alexander vows to take back his house and rescue his wife as he marches forward into the snow.
standalone_clarity: Viewers immediately grasp a classic 'return of the wronged hero' trope, even without prior context.
narrative_context: After years in hiding following a conspiracy against him, Alexander discards his disguise, puts on his ducal regalia, and marches out to reclaim his birthright and save Juliana.
promotional_strength: Features a powerful character transformation and high-stakes emotional payoff that hooks viewers on the protagonist's quest for vengeance and rescue.

evidence.observation: Alexander shears off his overgrown hair and beard.
Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor.
Alexander vows to bring his wife home.

logline: While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up framed into a cracked wooden wall mirror reflecting Alexander with long unkempt hair, a thick beard, and combat scars across his cheek.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tilt-down medium close-up over a wooden table displaying a pristine navy-and-gold embroidered ducal uniform, ornate lion crest brooch, white cravat, razor, and scissors.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile shot of Alexander lifting the metal shears beside the window light, raising them toward his hair.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander trims his beard at the jawline.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Steely Resolve)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Enough hiding.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Unforgiving)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Today, he comes home.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's hand adjusting the ornate golden lion crest pinned at his cravat.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium low-angle shot as a loyalist soldier drops down onto one knee before him in the snow.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST (Reverent, Submissive)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST
source_segments.text: Your Grace.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up profile of Alexander, his breath pluming in the winter cold, his eyes hardened like steel.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Command)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Secure the chapel.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the soldier rising and snapping a crisp military salute.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST (Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST
source_segments.text: Yes, Your Grace.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow dramatic tracking shot moving backward in front of Alexander as he strides purposefully through the deep snow, the wooden chapel looming in the distance behind him.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Powerful, Roaring Defiance)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: No more hiding.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Unyielding)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: I am taking back my house.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander marches forward unstoppably, his long coat fluttering in the winter wind as his icy gaze locks forward.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Dramatic push-in close-up directly onto Alexander's scarred, fierce face as he speaks with absolute conviction.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Passionate, Unstoppable Vow)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And I am bringing my wife home.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander's eyes burn with furious determination as the screen cuts sharply to black.

hook: An elder nobleman surveys the packed cathedral from a balcony, confirming that all exits are covered as part of their sinister plot.
cliffhanger: The elder nobleman smiles sinisterly, declaring that by sunset Ashburgh will have its new rulers and its witch will be dead.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can understand that a powerful conspiracy is locking down a venue to execute a captive labeled a 'witch', though the specific backstory of Juliana requires context.
narrative_context: While wedding preparations unfold, the conspirators lock down the cathedral and gloat over their imminent consolidation of power and Juliana's death.
promotional_strength: Highlights the arrogant confidence of the villains right before their plot faces retribution, creating high dramatic tension.

evidence.observation: The elder nobleman checks that all entrances are covered.
The elder nobleman declares that their witch will be dead by sunset.

logline: High society gathers at the grand cathedral for Rupert and Catherine's lavish wedding, while the conspirators ensure every exit is sealed to seal Juliana's execution—unaware that Alexander's retribution is already at their gates.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Scheming)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: All entrances are covered?

source_segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Obedient, Firm)
source_segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
source_segments.text: Every one, my Lord.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculating)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Good.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless, Victorious)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight, menacing close-up on the elder nobleman's face as a cold, sinister smile spreads across his lips.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadly, Uncompromising)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: And its witch will be dead.

hook: Catherine abruptly stops her lavish wedding to cruelly display what happens to a woman who defies her, leading to the dramatic entrance of a chained Juliana.
cliffhanger: Juliana stands in heavy iron shackles, her bruised face burning with fierce dignity as she faces her tormentors.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the high-stakes cruelty of a wedding disrupted to humiliate a captive rival, though background on why Juliana is imprisoned is missing.
narrative_context: Catherine stages a public humiliation of Juliana in the middle of her wedding to Rupert before Juliana is even sentenced.
promotional_strength: Provides a striking visual contrast between a lavish wedding and a brutal public shaming, driven by strong antagonistic stakes.

evidence.observation: Catherine abruptly halts her wedding to command silence.
Catherine expresses her sadistic desire to publicly punish a defiant woman.
Juliana is revealed bound in heavy iron shackles.

logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide symmetrical shot looking down the candlelit, flower-strewn aisle toward the altar where Rupert, Catherine, and the Priest stand.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Imperious, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Wait.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Haughty, Loud)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Resonant)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: ...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Subdued, Inquiring)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Catherine...

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Callous, Projecting)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Bring her in.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.

hook: An imposing nobleman steps through the smoke of a shattered cathedral doorway, instantly commanding attention as he faces a terrified crowd.
cliffhanger: Rupert screams in desperate denial that Alexander is dead, leaving the confrontation hanging in balance.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp a dramatic confrontation where a presumed dead man returns to shock his enemies, though the backstory of the usurper is missing.
narrative_context: Alexander confronts Rupert and wins over the royal guards inside the cathedral.
promotional_strength: High-stakes confrontation with strong visual imagery of an explosive return and immediate betrayal by the guards.

evidence.observation: Alexander strides through the pulverized cathedral doorway in ducal regalia.
The royal guard refuses Rupert's order to arrest Alexander.
The guard states they know who Alexander is.

logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot through drifting smoke and rubble across the stone floor, tilting up as polished boots step over splintered wood, revealing an imposing nobleman in a gold-embroidered navy coat.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shocked, Trembling)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Who are you?

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Resonant)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You already know.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Tearful Whisper)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Alexander...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Guards! Arrest this imposter!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.

source_segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
source_segments.text: We will not.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: I said arrest him!

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Why?!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.

source_segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent)
source_segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
source_segments.text: Because we know who he is.

hook: Alexander advances down the aisle as his mother rushes to embrace him in front of stunned onlookers.
cliffhanger: Alexander vows to settle what Rupert stole, leaving viewers anticipating the final retaliation.
standalone_clarity: A mother identifying her long-lost son as the rightful ruler is universally understandable, even if the specifics of the usurpation require context.
narrative_context: Alexander reunites with his mother, who proclaims him the rightful Duke before he threatens Rupert.
promotional_strength: Combines emotional payoff with a powerful climax and declaration of vengeance.

evidence.observation: Alexander's mother proclaims him as Alexander Ashburn, the rightful Duke of Ashburn.
Alexander confronts Rupert and vows to settle what was stolen.

logline: Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: Alexander...

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Mother.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tender, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: I have come home, Mother.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander's mother turns toward the gathered nobility and guards, raising her chin and pointing proudly toward Alexander.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
source_segments.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.

hook: Catherine approaches Alexander in tears, declaring her enduring love, only for him to coldly reject her touch and her claims.
cliffhanger: Alexander turns his back on Catherine and walks past her to his true bride, Juliana, leaving Catherine gasping in utter disbelief: 'Her?!'
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the intense emotional betrayal and romantic rejection, though prior context is needed to know why Juliana is in chains.
narrative_context: The dramatic fallout of Alexander's return, where he shatters Catherine's expectations by spurning her affections and turning toward Juliana.
promotional_strength: Features high emotional drama, a sharp rejection, and a satisfying twist where the hero bypasses the presumed love interest for the true heroine.

evidence.observation: Catherine steps away from Rupert and approaches Alexander.
Alexander abruptly pulls back, refusing Catherine's touch.
Catherine gasps in disbelief as Alexander chooses Juliana.

logline: As Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown, Catherine pleads with Alexander for their past love, only to be coldly rejected as he walks toward his chained bride, Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot as Catherine gathers her heavy train and steps away from Rupert, walking toward Alexander who stands watching her stoically.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Shaken, Tearful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's face, tears glistening in her eyes as grief breaks through her composure.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Choked, Weeping)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Do you know what this did to me?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot on Alexander standing tall in his ducal coat, his gaze utterly detached.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Pleading)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I mourned you.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Profile close-up of Catherine as a tear slips down her cheek.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Vulnerable, Trembling)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I waited for you.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing in the center of the aisle before the seated congregation.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Heartbroken)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tracking two-shot over Alexander's shoulder as Catherine approaches him pleadingly.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close profile two-shot as Catherine gently reaches her gloved hand up to Alexander's bearded cheek.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Longing)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I never stopped loving you.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander abruptly pulls his face back, refusing her touch and leaving her hand suspended in mid-air.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's empty gloved hand trembling in the empty space between them.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine lowering her hand, stunned and deeply hurt by his rejection.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Breathless, Hurt)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: You don't remember?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in the foreground, with Rupert held under guard in the background.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Desperate, Demanding)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of Catherine and Alexander confronting each other.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You were never my Duchess.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's tearful face.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Sobbing, Pleading)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: But I loved you!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up on Alexander, his scarred jaw set firm.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Scornful, Biting)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, gasping in protest.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Defiant, Pained)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: No!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Catherine clutches her chest, pouring her heart out.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Passionate, Crying)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I loved you before all this!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Alexander tilting his head slightly, his gaze piercing through her.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Skeptical, Cutting)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Did you?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, rendered speechless by his doubt.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tilt-up shot starting from heavy iron chains resting on the wooden floor up to the shackled wrists of Juliana dressed in her rustic grey gown.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot from behind Catherine as Alexander turns his back on her and walks resolutely down the rubble-strewn aisle toward Juliana standing in chains at the doorway.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander walks away from Catherine toward Juliana, who waits solemnly by the cathedral entrance.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana looking down at her chained hands, lifting her gaze gently.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on Catherine's horrified, bewildered expression as she realizes who Alexander chose.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Gasping, Incredulous)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Her?!

hook: Alexander unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists, revealing his true identity as the Duke of Ashburton.
cliffhanger: Alexander and Juliana share an intimate emotional exchange, vowing their love for one another before the hostile crowd.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand the emotional core: a man rescues a chained woman and reveals his noble identity. Missing context is the prior betrayal by the villains.
narrative_context: Alexander frees Juliana from her imprisonment and reveals his true identity as the rightful Duke of Ashburton.
promotional_strength: Features high emotional intensity, a satisfying rescue, and a powerful character reveal.

evidence.observation: Alexander removes the chains from Juliana's wrists.
Alexander proclaims himself as the rightful Duke of Ashburton.

logline: Alexander frees Juliana from her chains and proclaims her the Duchess of Ashburton before the stunned congregation, only for an ecclesiastical authority to burst in and declare their marriage legally invalid.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's hands as he unfastens the heavy iron lock and releases the chains from Juliana's bruised wrists.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy iron clanking as the shackles fall away.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she stares intently into his eyes.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Overcome)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Your eyes...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up profile of Alexander as Juliana reaches out her trembling hand to touch his bearded cheek and jawline.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana places her palm against Alexander's beard, feeling his scarred face as recognition dawns.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Emotional, Realizing)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: It's you.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Solemn, Loving)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: It was always me.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander stands up and drapes a heavy crimson ducal mantle lined with ermine over Juliana's shoulders.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander places the ducal cloak over Juliana's rustic gown, adjusting it gently over her shoulders.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Shocked, Wondering)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: You're the Duke?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Alexander looking intensely into her eyes.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Firm, Resonant)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, tears of awe spilling over her cheeks.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Incredulous, Moved)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: All this time?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up two-shot as Alexander tenderly cradles Juliana's cheek in his gloved hand.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Tender, Deep)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You chose me when you believed I was nobody.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Sincere, Loving)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I chose you because you were kind.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Passionate)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: You chose me when I had nothing.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot framed between them as Alexander holds her face with both hands, the crowd watching in stunned silence.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute, Warm)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I chose you because you had honor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander looking deep into Juliana's blue eyes.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Earnest, Devoted)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up as Alexander and Juliana rest their foreheads and noses together in an intimate embrace.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander and Juliana close their eyes, breathing together with their foreheads pressed gently against one another.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Heartfelt)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I loved you before I ever knew who you were.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Soft, Vowing)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you.

hook: The massive cathedral doors violently swing open as an ecclesiastical authority bursts in to halt the proceedings.
cliffhanger: Catherine displays a vindictive smirk as the High Priest declares the marriage legally invalid, leaving the protagonists' victory in jeopardy.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can grasp that an authority figure is disrupting a wedding or union with legal documents. Missing context is the specific backstory of the characters.
narrative_context: A High Priest interrupts Alexander and Juliana's union, declaring their marriage invalid before the Crown.
promotional_strength: Delivers an immediate plot twist and cliffhanger that creates high dramatic tension and hooks viewers for the next episode.

evidence.observation: The cathedral doors slam open as the High Priest enters.
Catherine smiles vindictively as Juliana's claim is challenged.

logline: Alexander frees Juliana from her chains and proclaims her the Duchess of Ashburton before the stunned congregation, only for an ecclesiastical authority to burst in and declare their marriage legally invalid.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Stern)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: No one will bow yet!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Official)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Unyielding, Condemning)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow push-in close-up on Catherine beneath her veil, her initial despair morphing into a cold, venomous, triumphant smile as the episode cuts.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine raises her chin, a vindictive smirk spreading across her lips as she realizes her rival's claim has just been torn to pieces.

hook: The High Priest marches down the ruined aisle with armed royal guards, immediately seizing the sanctuary and declaring Alexander's marriage invalid.
cliffhanger: The High Priest asserts that the marriage does not rise with Alexander's newfound status as a Duke, leaving the validity of their union in jeopardy.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp a hostile religious authority crashing a wedding with armed guards to invalidate a marriage. Missing context includes the prior history between the characters.
narrative_context: The High Priest interrupts Alexander and Juliana's wedding ceremony to enforce Crown seizure and challenge their marital status.
promotional_strength: Features high narrative tension, a sudden confrontation, and a strong visual intrusion that immediately hooks viewers into the conflict.

evidence.observation: High Priest marches forward with armed royal guards.
High Priest declares the sanctuary under Crown seizure.
High Priest dismisses the marriage because Alexander is now a Duke.

logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot down the ruined nave aisle as the High Priest marches forward flanked by armed royal guards with halberds.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: None shall leave until every witness is accounted for.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: You married this woman as a nameless beggar...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scornful, Harsh)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: ...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Resonant, Dismissive)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.

hook: The High Priest thunders that Alexander was presumed dead, prompting a fierce and defiant retort from Juliana.
cliffhanger: Juliana boldly proclaims that God married them and that the priest is only angry no one asked him first.
standalone_clarity: Viewers can understand a clash between an oppressive religious authority and a defiant bride defending her marriage. Background on Alexander's supposed death provides extra depth.
narrative_context: Juliana fiercely stands up to the High Priest's legalistic invalidation of her marriage.
promotional_strength: Captures a powerful emotional turning point with strong dialogue and passionate acting that highlights the protagonist's resilience.

evidence.observation: High Priest states Alexander was thought to be dead.
Juliana responds with fierce defiance.
Juliana declares God married them despite the priest's objections.

logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: A church called me unworthy.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: A church chained me.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

hook: Alexander confronts the High Priest face-to-face, demanding a ten-day trial before witnesses to settle the dispute.
cliffhanger: Catherine smiles wickedly and whispers that ten days is plenty of time, setting up an imminent threat.
standalone_clarity: A clear high-stakes negotiation ending in a tense countdown and a villainous plot twist. Easily understandable for new viewers.
narrative_context: Alexander negotiates a ten-day trial against the High Priest's decree while Catherine plots in the background.
promotional_strength: Combines a powerful display of authority by the male lead with a chilling villain teaser that creates immediate anticipation for the next episode.

evidence.observation: Alexander demands a trial in ten days.
Alexander orders the guards to lower their weapons.
Catherine smiles maliciously and says ten days is plenty of time.

logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

source_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning)
source_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
source_segments.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Malicious)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Ten days is plenty of time.

hook: Catherine stands silhouetted against the moonlight and turns with a cold, venomous smirk, vowing that a healer's crown belongs in the gutter.
cliffhanger: Catherine declares that ten days is not a wall but a door, and doors can be closed from the other side.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp that a vengeful antagonist is plotting against a rival's newfound status, though the specific background of the 'healer's crown' requires minor context.
narrative_context: Catherine alone in her chamber plotting her revenge during the ten-day window granted by the council.
promotional_strength: Features a strong villainous monologue filled with suspense and calculated menace that immediately hooks viewers interested in revenge plots.

evidence.observation: Catherine turns slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.
Catherine states menacingly that ten days is a door.

logline: While feigning submission after her public humiliation, Catherine schemes in secret, plotting to use the council's ten-day reprieve to strike back at Alexander and Juliana with the aid of Father Thomas.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Vindictive, Cold)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Intense, Measured)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Ten days for the council to sit.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Calculating)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Ten days for witnesses to be gathered.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Dark, Threatening)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Ten days for a decree to be undone.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Menacing, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Chillingly Calm)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And doors can be closed from the other side.

hook: Agnes enters cautiously and locks the door as Catherine seethes over being publicly humiliated, plotting a dangerous conspiracy.
cliffhanger: Agnes slips out into the darkness with a heavy coin purse to secretly summon Father Thomas under the Duke's watchful eye.
standalone_clarity: Demonstrates a secret conspiracy between a disgraced noblewoman and her servant, highlighting themes of betrayal and hidden plotting.
narrative_context: Catherine recruits Agnes to coordinate a clandestine meeting with Father Thomas to execute her counter-plot.
promotional_strength: Creates high tension through illicit plotting, closed-door conspiracy, and the risk of getting caught by bailiffs.

evidence.observation: Heavy metallic click of an iron key locking the door.
Catherine commands Agnes to send for the priest tonight.

logline: While feigning submission after her public humiliation, Catherine schemes in secret, plotting to use the council's ten-day reprieve to strike back at Alexander and Juliana with the aid of Father Thomas.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot over Catherine's shoulder seated before her vanity mirror as the chamber door eases open and Agnes enters quietly.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Agnes, dressed in a grey maid's dress and white apron, steps inside with cautious hesitation and clasps her hands.

source_segments.label: AGNES (Hushed, Submissive)
source_segments.speaker: AGNES
source_segments.text: You sent for me, my lady?

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Commanding, Sharp)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Lock it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Fierce, Hissing)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful, calculating)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Good. Let them remember it.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Sinister, Predatory)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.

source_segments.label: AGNES (Anxious, Whispering)
source_segments.speaker: AGNES
source_segments.text: My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Confident, Devious)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Pleased, Scheming)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Calculated, Demanding)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.

source_segments.label: AGNES (Apprehensive)
source_segments.speaker: AGNES
source_segments.text: If someone sees him come to you...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Threatening)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Then no one sees him.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: That is precisely your job tonight.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Hushed, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Send for the priest. Tonight.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Firm, Final)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And make sure no one sees him arrive.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Agnes curtsying swiftly, stashing the pouch into her apron, and hurrying out through the heavy wooden door into the darkness.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Exterior shot looking through the dark diamond-paned window frame at Catherine standing motionless in the warm candlelight, staring outward into the night with cold, unyielding ambition as the scene fades to black.

hook: Catherine bluntly tells Father Thomas to 'Name your price,' instantly shifting an intimate moment into a cold, dangerous political transaction.
cliffhanger: Father Thomas firmly clasps Catherine's hand, establishing a tense pact with the grave warning 'For as long as it holds.'
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the intense transactional power dynamic between a noblewoman and a man of the cloth, even without knowing the full backstory.
narrative_context: Catherine negotiates the price of Father Thomas's corrupt silence and cooperation during their secret liaison.
promotional_strength: The sharp pivot from romance to political extortion creates high dramatic tension and showcases the ruthless ambition of both characters.

Father Thomas demands control of the west territory's tax collection.

logline: Following their illicit passion in the abandoned manor wing, Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's corrupt silence with territorial control—unaware that Agnes has walked in and witnessed their scandalous intimacy.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Direct, Transactional)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Name your price.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.

source_segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Calculated, Demanding)
source_segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
source_segments.text: The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Scoffing, Incredulous)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.

source_segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Steady, Cold)
source_segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
source_segments.text: Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Soft, Calculating)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Unsupervised. In your hands alone.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.

source_segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Grave)
source_segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
source_segments.text: For as long as it holds.
